scope: independent Fractal forecast vs PLC emulator; same PLC snapshot and full physical second per emulator step; first interval shortened to the next absolute PLC hour boundary
note: Ordinal pairing is diagnostic, not proof of event identity if cycle counts differ. Emulator readings are taken at exact absolute PLC hour boundaries; levels, main flow and pressures are TRUE values (not noisy PLC sensor snapshots). Fractal shortens its first interval to the next absolute PLC boundary (e.g. 3570 s from an initial t=30 s), then uses complete 3600 s profile intervals. Both models use the same profile entry up to each comparison boundary. Fractal holds hourly distribution fixed. Fractal recirculation totals are accumulated across hours, no commands applied.
topology_revision: D78. Same assumed DN100/158 m3/h PRS and supply-tank checks, DN50/39 m3/h checks after each inter-floor regulator, DN80/86 m3/h return-tank checks, from the Spirax Sarco DCV6 published table, not installed-product identification.
alignment: Fixed: from snapshot t=30 s, first Fractal interval is 3570 s to absolute PLC boundary t=3600; following intervals are 3600 s. Emu/Fractal sampled at t=3600,7200,...,86400, and use the same profile hour in each interval.
limitations: Only 24 hourly boundary marks tested against 15 mca, not every second. Fractal still holds distribution fixed within each profile interval and main-pump control/staging remains an unverified approximation of the PLC black box. Event counts differ: Fractal 46 starts/46 stops, emulator 46 starts/45 stops. Levels are not validated; optimization disabled.
supersedes: The earlier pdd-rca-01-d78-interfloor-checks-24h report sampled t=3630,...,86430 and paired mismatched profile hours; do not use it for aligned comparison.
